# Once v0.2.0

Changes since v0.1.1, grouped by platform.

## Across all platforms

- **Redesigned settings** make sections easier to navigate and search, with
  structured editors for configurable values and clearer source descriptions.
- **Unified story context menus** provide consistent story actions across
  desktop, browser extensions, and mobile.
- **More reliable synchronization** adds visible CouchDB sync status, staged
  database synchronization, stronger story-state reconciliation, and a recovery
  helper for damaged remote story state.
- Starred stories are restored at startup, and extension multi-item undo is more
  reliable.
- Development and release builds now have clearer build identifiers and
  separated output directories.

## Mobile (Android & iOS)

- A major mobile redesign introduces compact story rows, anchored story menus,
  directional swipe gestures with configurable actions, refreshed navigation,
  and responsive settings panels.
- Reading now uses native embedded browser surfaces with improved reader and
  browser switching, redirect handling, current-story controls, comments access,
  text-to-speech behavior, and empty/loading/error states.
- Added native context menus and dialogs, plus pull-to-refresh in both the story
  list and reading browser.
- Improved touch handling, long-press feedback, filtering, tag icons, scrollbar
  behavior, startup layout, and gaps left after opening stories.
- Expanded Android and iOS release, deployment, visual-inspection, and native
  end-to-end test tooling, including wireless Android discovery.

## Electron (desktop)

- Settings have the new responsive layout and navigation used across Once.
- Fixed layout after restoring a window and added the unified story context menu.
- Development builds are easier to identify and use separate output from release
  builds.

## Extensions (Firefox & Chrome)

- Extensions receive the redesigned settings, unified story context menus,
  synchronization improvements, and restored starred-story state.
- Fixed multi-item undo and improved settings navigation coverage in both
  Firefox and Chrome.
